thread:
viv: Heads up — customer saw duplicate billing when WS resumed to different shard after idle. Console shows one connection. Billing shows two resume charges.

kai: do we have headers / trace id? sounds like affinity TTL race.

viv: pasted headers: `X-Resume-Session: s-9f3a`, client sends resume quickly. Proxy routed to shard-B (no lease), shard-B billed, later shard-A got resume and billed too.

amar: current lease store is soft-state in memcache with eventual propagation. We trade strong consistency for latency, but this race is expected.

viv: customer impact small but visible on usage graph — spikes and support tickets.

console-bot: suggestion: expose "session lease timeline" in connection diagnostics with rows: claim, seen, billed. Off by default.

kai: proposals: (A) bump proxy affinity TTL to 45s for streaming routes + sticky cookie; (B) emit lease_claim kafka event before billing and have shards defer billing for 5-10s if claim detected. Hybrid looks plausible.

amar: runtime change: attach `lease_id` and `lease_epoch` to billing events so billing can dedupe. Billing, can you accept dedupe on lease_id?

billing-bot: we can dedupe on lease_id if consistently provided. Recommend dedupe TTL=45s and nightly reconciliation job to fix remaining duplicates. Deferred-billing is more complex; prefer reconciliation first.

viv: console UX: when duplicate_quota rate > threshold, show "possible duplicate charge" warning on tenant billing page with link to traces and CSV export for support.

kai: also add tenant-level sampling `stream.lease_telemetry.sample_rate` default 0.02 to emit full lease lifecycle events. Gate events behind sampling to avoid noise.

amar: edge idea: HMAC-backed resume token that only original shard can validate — other shards would detect non-owner and avoid billing. More invasive.

deploy-bot: canary created: ws-lease-ttl-bump -> eng-platform-us-east-1 (5% traffic).

viv: action items: amar prototype lease_claim + attach lease_id to billing events; kai wire sampling flag and console timeline mock; billing implement dedupe plan and reconciliation job; viv open RFC with traces and recommended defaults.

viv: timeline: sync with finance/product next Tue to finalize dedupe policy. Filing RFC now.

viv: end thread
